app.name: Rezzo
app.tagline: From a full episode to vertical clips for Reels, TikTok and Shorts

home.noRecent: Projects you open or save show up here.
home.free: Free and open source (GPL-3.0). No watermark, no subscription.

unsaved.title: Save changes to “{{name}}”?
unsaved.body: If you don't save, your changes will be lost.

open.too-new: {{path}} was saved by a newer version of Rezzo. Update the app to open it.
open.invalid: The project {{path}} is damaged and can't be opened.

import.unreadable: {{path}} can't be read as a video.

locate.different: That's a different video. Choose the file this project was made from.

transcribe.no-audio: This video has no sound to transcribe.

episode.changed: The video at {{path}} has changed since it was imported.

transcribe.title: Transcript
transcribe.languageHelp: Pick the language people speak in this video. The transcript is always written in Latin script.
transcribe.download: The first transcription downloads speech recognition once ({{size}} GB).
transcribe.cpu: No NVIDIA graphics card found, so this runs on the processor. Expect it to take about half as long as the video.
transcribe.noAudio: This video has no sound to transcribe.
transcribe.busy: Another project is being transcribed. This one can start when that one is done.

transcript.editHelp: Enter: done · Tab: next word · Ctrl+↓: next unsure word · Ctrl+Space: listen · Esc: cancel

player.preparing: This video can't be played directly, so Rezzo is making a preview copy: {{percent}}%
player.failed: This video can't be played here: {{detail}}

clips.title: Clips
clips.empty: Select words in the transcript to make a clip from them.
clips.tooLong: A clip can be at most {{minutes}} minutes long.
clips.cutWordsHelp: Leaves these words out of the open clip. Click the cut on the timeline to bring them back.
clips.newHelp: Pick words in the transcript to make another clip

clipEditor.name: Clip name

layoutHelp.follow: One crop that follows the speaker
layoutHelp.split: Two crops, one above the other
layoutHelp.full: The whole picture over a blurred copy of itself

clipEditor.dragHint: Drag the picture to frame it, scroll to zoom.
clipEditor.smooth: Move smoothly to the next one
clipEditor.deleteKeyframeHelp: Works on the keyframe under the playhead: click its diamond on the timeline first. The Delete key does the same.
clipEditor.keyframeHelp: Without keyframes the framing holds for the whole clip. Add one where the framing should change, then move the picture there.
clipEditor.wordHelp: Click to go to the word, double-click to correct it. Drag an edge to move its start or end; Alt+←/→ moves the start nearest the playhead by a frame.

timeline.overviewHelp: The whole clip in small. Drag the box to move along it, drag its edges to zoom.
timeline.inView: Part of the clip in view
timeline.resize: Drag to make the timeline taller or shorter

sizes.compactHelp: Just the rows, the most room for the picture
sizes.normalHelp: The rows and the word timing; drag the top edge to resize
sizes.fullHelp: The timeline fills the window, the picture moves into a column beside it

tools.title: Tools

help.layers: Images, videos and animations over the picture
help.voices: Who talks, and the episode's voices

tools.layersHint: Added from the playhead on. Press a layer on the timeline to change it.
tools.effectsHint: Added from the playhead on. Press an effect on the timeline to change it.
tools.voicesHint: Turn on Show people under the picture to say who talks.

export.buttonHelp: Save the clip as a 1080×1920 MP4
export.title: Exporting “{{name}}”

running.title: An export is running
running.body: Stop it? The unfinished file is deleted.

export.missingFiles: These files can't be found, so the clip can't be exported: {{names}}. Find them in the layer settings.

replacements.title: Replacement list
replacements.help: Words Whisper keeps getting wrong, fixed in every new transcript. A * at the end matches any ending: futbal* → fudbal* also fixes “futbala”.
replacements.buttonHelp: Words to fix in every transcript
replacements.saveFailed: The replacement list couldn't be saved. A word can be at most 100 characters long and its replacement 200.

captions.title: Captions
captions.addFontHelp: Use a TTF or OTF font file from this computer
captions.fontLacks: {{family}} has no {{letters}}. Those letters will be drawn in Poppins.
captions.fontUnreadable: That file isn't a font Rezzo can read.
captions.fontMissing: {{family}} isn't on this computer, so these captions are drawn in Poppins Bold. Add the font to see them as they were made.
captions.positionHelp: Drag the captions up or down in the preview. Split has its own place. Add a keyframe where they should move.
captions.drag: Captions: drag up or down to move them
captions.madeDefault: New clips will get this style.
captions.newPageHelp: Start a new caption page at the word being spoken
captions.joinPageHelp: This word starts a caption page; join it with the page before

layers.addHelp: Add a layer over the picture, from the playhead on
layers.moveBar: {{name}}: drag to move it in time
layers.title: Image: {{name}}
layers.missing: {{name}} isn't at {{path}} anymore, so it isn't shown.
layers.placeHelp: Drag the image in the preview to move it, its corners to resize it and the round handle to turn it. Shift turns off snapping.
layers.keyframeHelp: Without keyframes the image stays put for its whole time. Add one where it should move, then move it there.

errors.unreadable: That file isn't an image Rezzo can read.
errors.too-large: That image is too large (over 100 MB).
errors.different-file: That's a different file. Choose the one this project used.

video.unreadable: That file isn't a video Rezzo can read.

errors.tooManyVideos: At most {{count}} videos can show at the same moment. Make room on the timeline first.

lottie.unreadable: That file isn't a Lottie animation Rezzo can read.
lottie.too-large: That animation is too large (over 50 MB).
lottie.external-images: That animation shows image files kept next to it. Export it with the images inside, or as a .lottie file, and try again.

layers.videoHelp: Without starting over, the last frame stays up once the video ends, and the sound stops.
layers.overLimit: At most {{count}} videos can show at the same moment. Where more overlap, this one isn't shown.
layers.picking: Click the colour to remove in the preview
layers.lottieHelp: Without starting over, the last frame stays up once the animation ends.

effects.title: Effect: {{name}}
effects.help: An effect changes everything under it on the timeline, captions included if it sits above them. Keyframes on the intensity bring it in and out.

analysis.showPeopleHelp: Draws the heads the analysis found in this shot

speakers.title: Who talks now
speakers.pick: Click if this person is talking now
speakers.unpick: Take back that this person is talking now

why.left: The other person is placed, so it must be this one
why.group: Can't tell who talks: click the person
why.held: Nobody talks: staying on this person

autoFrame.title: Automatic framing
autoFrame.buttonHelp: Frames the whole clip from who talks, in place of its framing and layouts
autoFrame.shotHelp: Frames only the shot at the playhead again, and leaves the rest of the clip alone
autoFrame.waiting: Waits for the clip analysis and the voices

silence.title: Removing pauses
silence.findHelp: Marks the pauses on the timeline. Nothing is cut until you say so.
silence.noSound: Waits for the clip, which has to have sound
silence.pauseHelp: Click to keep or remove this pause
silence.skipHelp: Cut from the clip. Click to bring it back.
